[[File:Tribe Selection Menu.png|thumb|The tribe selection menu]]

{{for|resource spawn rate modifiers|Map Generation#Spawn Rate Modifiers by Tribe{{!}}Map Generation|the playable civilizations}}

'''Tribes''' are civilizations that players play as. Each tribe has a unique starting [[technology]] and [[Map Generation#Spawn Rate Modifiers by Tribe|resource spawn rates]]. There are sixteen tribes, including twelve regular tribes and four special tribes, which each have their own unique technology tree, units, and buildings.

Tribes are unlocked via microtransactions. On mobile, four tribes—[[Xin-xi]], [[Imperius]], [[Bardur]], and [[Oumaji]]—are available for free; the others are available as in-app purchases that cost from $0.99 to $2.99 USD. On Steam, all regular tribes are included in the base game, and special tribes are available as DLC. Purchases help to pay for game development, maintain servers, and keep the game free of advertisements.<ref>{{cite web|title = Support|website = The Battle of Polytopia|link = https://polytopia.io/support/|quote = We have chosen to create a game that is free from ads. This means that we need to have in-app purchases so we can keep developing the game.}}</ref>

Each tribe has a unique cosmetic design for [[terrain]], [[units]], [[cities]], and [[monuments]]. Each tribe also has its own music and ambience, which plays when its "native" tiles are selected. For instance, a rattlesnake is heard on Oumaji tiles, and howling wind and wolves are heard on Bardur tiles. Every tribe starts the game with one unit in its capital. Most tribes start with a [[Warrior]]. Some tribes start with the unit associated with their starting [[technology]].

More tribes will continue to be added in the future; however, all future tribes will be special tribes.<ref>Zoythrus on [https://www.reddit.com/r/Polytopia/comments/k5qgz2/every_polytopia_tribe_matched_with_the/gehte6j Reddit]</ref> 

== List of Tribes ==

There are two types of tribes:

* '''Regular tribes''', formerly known as human tribes, all share the same technology tree, units, and buildings.
* '''Special tribes''' each have a unique technology tree, units, and buildings.

On mobile, the first four regular tribes ([[Xin-xi]], [[Imperius]], [[Bardur]], and [[Oumaji]]) are free; the other regular tribes cost $0.99 USD each to unlock, except Luxidoor, which costs $2.99 USD. Special tribes cost $1.99 USD each.

The Steam version includes all regular tribes. Special tribes $2.99 USD each.

==Tribe Skins==

Each of the tribes has a cosmetic skin, which can be purchased through microtransactions. These skins change the tribe's music, units, cities, and sometimes terrain. The Forgotten skin and the New Dawn skin also change the tribe color and are currently the only skins to do so.

==Tribe Name Pronunciations==

The official pronunciations<ref>{{Cite social media|author=Zoythrus|website=Discord|date=19 Oct 2021|link=https://discord.com/channels/283436219780825088/561211722296197120/900055071822323764}}</ref> for the tribe names are:  

*Xin-xi: Chin-chee
*Imperius: Im-peer-ee-us
*Bardur: Bar-dur
*Oumaji: Oo-mah-zhee
*Kickoo: Ki-koo
*Hoodrick: Hoo-drick
*Luxidoor: Lux-ih-door
*Zebasi: Zeh-bah-see
* Vengir: Ven-geer (not Ven-jeer, but a hard G, as in "graph" or "good")
* Ai-Mo: I-mo
*Quetzali: Ket-zah-lee (not "Qu" like you'd expect, but "K", to mirror the Spanish pronunciation)
* Yadakk: Yad-ak
*Aquarion: Ah-quar-ee-on
*Elyrion: Eee-leer-ee-on
*Polaris: Po-lar-is
*Cymanti: Sih-mahn-tee

==Disabling Tribes==

[[File:Disabled Tribe Example.png|thumb|The Xin-Xi tribe has been disabled, as shown by its greyed-out tribe head.]]

{{Quote|Tribe disabled; it cannot be used by you or the AI.|In-game description}}

A player can disable a tribe, which prevents the player and their opponents from picking the tribe. This is done in the tribe picker menu; pressing and holding a tribe head disables (or enables) all other tribes.  

Disabling tribes does not decrease the maximum number of opponents allowed; multiple opponents can play as the same tribe (albeit using different colors) when necessary.
